message: You know that feeling when you’ve been telling everyone to prepare for a storm, and then it finally shows up? Yep, that’s me right now, feeling a bit smug. It’s a great reminder to check in on how we handle heat and stay safe during those sweltering days. If you haven't already, it might be worth a peek to brush up on some tips—nothing like being the cool one in the family! How do you keep your cool when the weather heats up? ☀️
